name: v1.263.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Bump arbitrary from 1.4.2 to 1.5.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2772
* mutate: Remove `eq-associates` rewrite rules by @tamaroning in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2776
* wit-parser: reject @external-id where it isn't supported by @jrandolf in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2781
* mutate: Remove algebric rewrites that breaks semantics by @tamaroning in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2774
* wast: support map values by @jrandolf in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2784
* wasm-wave: return an error instead of panicking on unsupported values by @jrandolf in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2778
* Expose the types within a `ModuleType` by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2786
* wast: accept import/export attributes in any order by @jrandolf in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2780
* Update spec test suite by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2787
* wasm-wave: support the component model map type by @jrandolf in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2782
* Bump wit-bindgen from 0.62.0 to 0.63.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2788
* mutate: Don't reorder, drop or duplicate effectful operands by @tamaroning in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2775
* Move recursion in `wasmprinter` to the heap by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2790
* Reject handles in the value types of maps by @jrandolf in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2791
* Plumb wasm features through reencoding/printing by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2797
* Implement the acquire-release-atomics proposal by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2799
* wasmprinter: fix outer aliases that print unparsable or shadowed identifiers by @jrandolf in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2795
* wast: parse core rec groups in component and instance types by @jrandolf in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2798
* Implement the multibyte-array-access proposal by @alexcrichton in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2800
* wit-parser: fix panics decoding WIT from components by @jrandolf in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2794
* Bump wasmtime from 49.0.1 to 50.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2801
* wasm-wave: require commas between record/flag/map entries per the grammar by @willemschots in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2802
* Release wasm-tools 1.263.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2803

## New Contributors
* @tamaroning made their first contribution in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2776
* @jrandolf made their first contribution in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2781
* @willemschots made their first contribution in https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/pull/2802

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/compare/v1.262.0...v1.263.0
